versions.changelog:
Zerq v0.0.1 — initial "name reservation" release

- Provides a structured framework for root cause analysis of quality issues using the ZerQ (ZeroQ) method: five technical and five management principles.
- Suitable for cause analysis, 8D/corrective action, root cause reports, and validation scenarios.
- This version is a minimal, foundational release reserving the package name; the full multi-layer framework is coming soon.
- Does not access network, external APIs, or sensitive system features.
- Focuses on guidance and analysis structure; does not generate judgments or replace professional engineering evaluation.
